market_notes: English is the lingua franca for international visitors (UK, US, Australia, backpackers from everywhere). Vocabulary differs by origin — motorbike (UK/AU), scooter, motorcycle (US) — and the Ha Giang Loop drives much north-Vietnam interest. Recurring worries are IDP validity, travel-insurance exclusions, passports held as deposits and the 'blue card' registration paper.
